cond_0048.intro: We are looking for a Clin/Tran Research Coordinator I to join our team.
cond_0048.responsibilities:
With assistance, prepares and processes new IRB research proposals, amendments, continuing review applications and adverse event reports according to institutional and departmental policies and procedures and federal regulations
Prepares and processes data for analysis and upload to sponsor-mandated data-sharing repositories. Assists with data management and analysis using Redcap, SQL, R, and Python
Screens and schedules study participants, working collaboratively with participants, other staff and trainees, and departments to complete research protocols including behavioral data collection, neuroimaging data collection, questionnaire and interview data collection. Follows an established protocol faithfully and meticulously to ensure data integrity across all forms of data collection
Procures equipment and supplies needed to fulfill project requirements
Works to recruit potential study participants by coordinating with other laboratories and/or departments/centers, community groups, and online social platforms
Collaboratively participates in study team meetings and initiates regular check-ins with principal investigator. Maintains open and positive communication with investigators, research staff, sponsors, participants, and representatives of professional organizations, participant advocates, and the public responsible for, or concerned about, protections for human participants of research
Participates in the ongoing informed consent process, ensuring that human subjects, their families, and other health care providers clearly understand what is expected of and from them in the course of participating in a research study
Supervises undergraduates in following protocols for data entry, coding, and verification
Demonstrates initiative for continuous learning, both self-directed and as evidenced by attendance of educational and professional development opportunities. Actively seeks new learning opportunities, seeing learning as part of work
Maintains rapport with research participants, including sending follow-up information as requested, thank you notes, and research newsletters. Furthers knowledge base by attending a Basic Research 101 within first three months of employment date
cond_0048.requirements:
Bachelor's degree in psychology, neuroscience, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Some exposure to human subject research and patient recruiting is helpful but not required. We consider relevant coursework, volunteer work, or training as well.
Willingness to develop organizational, interpersonal, and data management skills; some background in these areas is a plus.
Technical Capabilities
Project Coordination (Fundamental Awareness): Some experience, training, or exposure to project coordination is welcome. Has worked on at least one project in a support role, or is open to building this experience. Familiarity with collecting and collating project-related materials such as project initiation documents, project status reports, project metrics, and project completion data.
Study Design & Conduct (Fundamental Awareness): Working knowledge of qualitative and quantitative research methods to support preparatory, regulatory, and analytic tasks within the life cycle of a study.
Communication (Fundamental Awareness): Ability to communicate clearly, effectively, and respectfully with employees or customers.
Clinical Research (Fundamental Awareness): Familiarity with primary resources available to accomplish the job. Ability to research simple clinical questions pertaining to the functional area. Comfort with filing and collating trial documentation and reports, archiving study documentation and correspondence, and applying a systematic approach to problem solving.

cond_0117.intro: We are looking for a Clin/Tran Research Coordinator I to join our team in the Psychiatry Central Admin organization. This role is responsible for coordinating the approval processes and conduct of research protocols, working with guidance to maintain the integrity and quality of clinical/translational research and ensure it is conducted in accordance with all applicable policies and regulations.
cond_0117.responsibilities:
With assistance, prepares and processes new IRB research proposals, amendments, continuing review applications, and adverse event reports according to institutional and departmental policies and procedures and federal regulations.
Prepares and processes data for analysis and upload to sponsor-mandated data-sharing repositories. Assists with data management and analysis using Redcap, SQL, R, and Python.
Coordinates with participants, other staff and trainees, and departments to screen and schedule study participants and complete research protocols including behavioral data collection, neuroimaging data collection, and questionnaire and interview data collection. Follows an established protocol faithfully and meticulously to help ensure data integrity across all forms of data collection.
Procures equipment and supplies needed to fulfill project requirements.
Supports recruitment of potential study participants by coordinating with other laboratories and/or departments/centers, community groups, and online social platforms.
Participates collaboratively in study team meetings and initiates regular check-ins with the principal investigator. Maintains open and positive communication with investigators, research staff, sponsors, participants, and representatives of professional organizations, participant advocates, and the public responsible for, or concerned about, protections for human participants of research.
Participates in the ongoing informed consent process, helping to ensure that human subjects, their families, and other health care providers clearly understand what is expected of and from them in the course of participating in a research study.
Supervises undergraduates in following protocols for data entry, coding, and verification.
Demonstrates initiative for continuous learning, both self-directed and as evidenced by attendance of educational and professional development opportunities. Actively seeks new learning opportunities, seeing learning as part of work.
Maintains rapport with research participants, including sending follow-up information as requested, thank you notes, and research newsletters. Furthers knowledge base by attending a Basic Research 101 within first three months of employment date.
cond_0117.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's Degree in psychology, neuroscience, or related field
Strong organizational, interpersonal, and data management skills
Project Coordination (Fundamental Awareness): Has light experience, training, direct exposure, or past experience with Project Coordination. Has worked on at least one project in a support role. Collects and collates project related material such as project initiation documents, project status reports, project metrics, and project completion data.
Communication (Fundamental Awareness): Clearly, effectively and respectfully communicates to employees or customers.
Clinical Research (Fundamental Awareness): Knows the primary resources available to accomplish the job. Can successfully research simple clinical questions pertaining to the functional area. Files and collates trial documentation and reports. Archives study documentation and correspondence. Demonstrates a systematic approach to problem solving.
Preferred Requirements
Prior experience with human subject research and patient recruiting
Study Design & Conduct (Fundamental Awareness): Applies qualitative and quantitative research methods to perform preparatory, regulatory, and analytic tasking within the life cycle of a study.
Less than 1 year of relevant work experience

cond_0126.intro: We are looking for a Clin/Tran Research Coordinator I to join our team in the Psychiatry Central Admin organization. This role is responsible for coordinating the approval processes and conduct of research protocols, working with guidance to maintain the integrity and quality of clinical/translational research and ensure it is conducted in accordance with all applicable policies.
cond_0126.responsibilities:
With assistance, prepares and processes new IRB research proposals, amendments, continuing review applications and adverse event reports according to institutional and departmental policies and procedures and federal regulations.
Prepares and processes data for analysis and upload to sponsor-mandated data-sharing repositories. Assists with data management and analysis using Redcap, SQL, R, and Python.
Coordinates with participants, other staff and trainees, and departments to screen and schedule study participants and complete research protocols including behavioral data collection, neuroimaging data collection, questionnaire and interview data collection. Follows an established protocol faithfully and meticulously to ensure data integrity across all forms of data collection.
Procures equipment and supplies needed to fulfill project requirements.
Works to recruit potential study participants by coordinating with other laboratories and/or departments/centers, community groups, and online social platforms.
Participates in study team meetings and maintains regular check-ins with the principal investigator. Keeps open and positive communication with investigators, research staff, sponsors, participants, and representatives of professional organizations, participant advocates, and the public responsible for, or concerned about, protections for human participants of research.
Supports the ongoing informed consent process, helping to ensure that human subjects, their families, and other health care providers clearly understand what is expected of and from them in the course of participating in a research study.
Supervises undergraduates in following protocols for data entry, coding, and verification.
Demonstrates initiative for continuous learning, both self-directed and as evidenced by attendance of educational and professional development opportunities. Actively seeks new learning opportunities, seeing learning as part of work.
Maintains rapport with research participants, including sending follow-up information as requested, thank you notes, and research newsletters. Furthers knowledge base by attending a Basic Research 101 within first three months of employment date.
cond_0126.requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in psychology, neuroscience, or related field.
Prior experience with human subject research and patient recruiting is preferred.
Strong organizational, interpersonal, and data management skills.
Project Coordination (Fundamental Awareness): Has light experience, training, direct exposure, or past experience with Project Coordination. Has worked on at least one project in a support role. Collects and collates project related material such as project initiation documents, project status reports, project metrics, and project completion data.
Study Design & Conduct (Fundamental Awareness): Applies qualitative and quantitative research methods to perform preparatory, regulatory, and analytic tasking within the life cycle of a study.
Communication (Fundamental Awareness): Clearly, effectively and respectfully communicates to employees or customers.
Clinical Research (Fundamental Awareness): Knows the primary resources available to accomplish the job. Can successfully research simple clinical questions pertaining to the functional area. Files and collates trial documentation and reports. Archives study documentation and correspondence. Demonstrates a systematic approach to problem solving.
Less than 1 year of relevant work experience.

With assistance, prepares and processes new IRB research proposals, amendments, continuing review applications and adverse event reports according to institutional and departmental policies and procedures and federal regulations
Prepares and processes data for analysis and upload to sponsor-mandated data-sharing repositories. Assists with data management and analysis using Redcap, SQL, R, and Python
Screens and schedules study participants, working collaboratively with participants, other staff and trainees, and departments to complete research protocols including behavioral data collection, neuroimaging data collection, questionnaire and interview data collection. Follows an established protocol faithfully and meticulously to ensure data integrity across all forms of data collection
Procures equipment and supplies needed to fulfill project requirements
Works to recruit potential study participants by coordinating with other laboratories and/or departments/centers, community groups, and online social platforms
Collaboratively participates in study team meetings and initiates regular check-ins with principal investigator. Maintains open and positive communication with investigators, research staff, sponsors, participants, and representatives of professional organizations, participant advocates, and the public responsible for, or concerned about, protections for human participants of research
Participates in the ongoing informed consent process, ensuring that human subjects, their families, and other health care providers clearly understand what is expected of and from them in the course of participating in a research study
Supervises undergraduates in following protocols for data entry, coding, and verification
Demonstrates initiative for continuous learning, both self-directed and as evidenced by attendance of educational and professional development opportunities. Actively seeks new learning opportunities, seeing learning as part of work
Maintains rapport with research participants, including sending follow-up information as requested, thank you notes, and research newsletters. Furthers knowledge base by attending a Basic Research 101 within first three months of employment date
cond_0146.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in psychology, neuroscience, or related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Demonstrated expertise in human subject research and patient recruiting.
Exceptional organizational, interpersonal, and data management skills.
Deep knowledge of Project Coordination, including experience in a support role on at least one project; strong command of collecting and collating project-related materials such as initiation documents, status reports, metrics, and completion data.
Proven ability to apply qualitative and quantitative research methods to perform preparatory, regulatory, and analytic tasks across the life cycle of a study.
Exceptional communication skills — communicates clearly, effectively, and respectfully with employees and participants.
Preferred Requirements
Advanced knowledge of clinical research resources and the ability to address clinical questions pertaining to the functional area; demonstrated systematic approach to problem solving, including filing, collating, and archiving trial documentation and correspondence.

With assistance, prepares and processes new IRB research proposals, amendments, continuing review applications and adverse event reports according to institutional and departmental policies and procedures and federal regulations
Prepares and processes data for analysis and upload to sponsor-mandated data-sharing repositories. Assists with data management and analysis using Redcap, SQL, R, and Python
Screens and schedules study participants, working collaboratively with participants, other staff and trainees, and departments to complete research protocols including behavioral data collection, neuroimaging data collection, questionnaire and interview data collection. Follows an established protocol faithfully and meticulously to ensure data integrity across all forms of data collection
Procures equipment and supplies needed to fulfill project requirements
Works to recruit potential study participants by coordinating with other laboratories and/or departments/centers, community groups, and online social platforms
Collaboratively participates in study team meetings and initiates regular check-ins with principal investigator. Maintains open and positive communication with investigators, research staff, sponsors, participants, and representatives of professional organizations, participant advocates, and the public responsible for, or concerned about, protections for human participants of research
Participates in the ongoing informed consent process, ensuring that human subjects, their families, and other health care providers clearly understand what is expected of and from them in the course of participating in a research study
Supervises undergraduates in following protocols for data entry, coding, and verification
Demonstrates initiative for continuous learning, both self-directed and as evidenced by attendance of educational and professional development opportunities. Actively seeks new learning opportunities, seeing learning as part of work
Maintains rapport with research participants, including sending follow-up information as requested, thank you notes, and research newsletters. Furthers knowledge base by attending a Basic Research 101 within first three months of employment date
cond_0165.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in psychology, neuroscience, or related field, or equivalent practical experience
Familiarity with organizational, interpersonal, and data management tasks
Some exposure to Project Coordination, such as supporting a project in a support role or collecting project-related materials
Background in qualitative and quantitative research methods, including preparatory, regulatory, or analytic tasks within a study
Ability to communicate clearly, effectively, and respectfully with employees or customers
Working knowledge of clinical research basics, including filing and collating trial documentation and a systematic approach to problem solving
Preferred Requirements
Around a year or less of relevant work experience, or an equivalent combination of education and training
Prior experience with human subject research and participant recruiting
Experience with or willingness to learn tools such as Redcap, SQL, R, and Python for data management and analysis

cond_0218.intro: We are looking for a Clin/Tran Research Coordinator I to join our team.
cond_0218.responsibilities:
With assistance, prepares and processes new IRB research proposals, amendments, continuing review applications and adverse event reports according to institutional and departmental policies and procedures and federal regulations
Prepares and processes data for analysis and upload to sponsor-mandated data-sharing repositories. Assists with data management and analysis using Redcap, SQL, R, and Python
Screens and schedules study participants, working collaboratively with participants, other staff and trainees, and departments to complete research protocols including behavioral data collection, neuroimaging data collection, questionnaire and interview data collection. Follows an established protocol faithfully and meticulously to ensure data integrity across all forms of data collection
Procures equipment and supplies needed to fulfill project requirements
Works to recruit potential study participants by coordinating with other laboratories and/or departments/centers, community groups, and online social platforms
Collaboratively participates in study team meetings and initiates regular check-ins with principal investigator. Maintains open and positive communication with investigators, research staff, sponsors, participants, and representatives of professional organizations, participant advocates, and the public responsible for, or concerned about, protections for human participants of research
Participates in the ongoing informed consent process, ensuring that human subjects, their families, and other health care providers clearly understand what is expected of and from them in the course of participating in a research study
Supervises undergraduates in following protocols for data entry, coding, and verification
Demonstrates initiative for continuous learning, both self-directed and as evidenced by attendance of educational and professional development opportunities. Actively seeks new learning opportunities, seeing learning as part of work
Maintains rapport with research participants, including sending follow-up information as requested, thank you notes, and research newsletters. Furthers knowledge base by attending a Basic Research 101 within first three months of employment date
cond_0218.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Bachelor's degree in psychology, neuroscience, or related field required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Demonstrated expertise in human subject research and patient recruiting.
Exceptional organizational, interpersonal, and data management skills.
Deep knowledge of Project Coordination, including experience in a support role on at least one project; strong command of collecting and collating project-related materials such as initiation documents, status reports, metrics, and completion data.
Proven ability to apply qualitative and quantitative research methods to perform preparatory, regulatory, and analytic tasks across the life cycle of a study.
Exceptional communication skills — communicates clearly, effectively, and respectfully with employees and participants.
Preferred Requirements
Advanced knowledge of clinical research resources and the ability to address clinical questions pertaining to the functional area; demonstrated systematic approach to problem solving, including filing, collating, and archiving trial documentation and correspondence.

cond_0265.intro: Responsible for coordinating the approval processes and conduct of research protocols, such that the integrity and quality of the clinical/translational research is maintained and the research is conducted in accordance within all policies, with some guidance. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the processes and logic behind clinical and translational research work.
cond_0265.responsibilities:
With assistance, prepares and processes new IRB research proposals, amendments, continuing review applications and adverse event reports according to institutional and departmental policies and procedures and federal regulations
Prepares and processes data for analysis and upload to sponsor-mandated data-sharing repositories. Assists with data management and analysis using Redcap, SQL, R, and Python
Screens and schedules study participants, working collaboratively with participants, other staff and trainees, and departments to complete research protocols including behavioral data collection, neuroimaging data collection, questionnaire and interview data collection. Follows an established protocol faithfully and meticulously to ensure data integrity across all forms of data collection
Procures equipment and supplies needed to fulfill project requirements
Works to recruit potential study participants by coordinating with other laboratories and/or departments/centers, community groups, and online social platforms
Collaboratively participates in study team meetings and initiates regular check-ins with principal investigator. Maintains open and positive communication with investigators, research staff, sponsors, participants, and representatives of professional organizations, participant advocates, and the public responsible for, or concerned about, protections for human participants of research
Participates in the ongoing informed consent process, ensuring that human subjects, their families, and other health care providers clearly understand what is expected of and from them in the course of participating in a research study
Supervises undergraduates in following protocols for data entry, coding, and verification
Demonstrates initiative for continuous learning, both self-directed and as evidenced by attendance of educational and professional development opportunities. Actively seeks new learning opportunities, seeing learning as part of work
Maintains rapport with research participants, including sending follow-up information as requested, thank you notes, and research newsletters. Furthers knowledge base by attending a Basic Research 101 within first three months of employment date
